item.title: Head-on crash in Falmouth sends one person to hospital
item.description: FALMOUTH – A head-on crash about 2:30 PM Friday sent one person to Falmouth Hospital. The collision happened on Teaticket Highway (Route 28) by Aubuchon Hardware. item.title: Vehicle rolls on its roof on Route 25 before Bourne Bridge
item.description: BOURNE – A vehicle rolled on its roof in the median of Route 25 eastbound before the Bourne Bridge just after 7 AM Saturday. All of the occupants were able to self-extricate from the vehicle. They were evaluated at the scene. Mass State Police are investigating if icy roads played a role in the crash. item.title: Vehicle strikes utility pole and overturns in Harwich
item.description: HARWICH – A vehicle struck a utility pole and overturned in Harwich shortly after 8 PM Saturday. The crash happened on Orleans Road (Route 39) by Church Street. The driver was not injures. Eversource was called to check the pole. Harwich Police are investigating if black ice was a factor in the crash. item.title: Driver facing multiple charges after failing to stop for Eastham Police
item.description: EASTHAM – A motorist allegedly failed to stop for police in Eastham around 9:30 PM Saturday evening. A pursuit ensued on Route 6 all the way to the rest area by the Bass River in Yarmouth where the driver was taken into custody. CWN is checking with Eastham Police for further details. item.title: Bourne Fire sets milestone having responded to most calls in a single year ever
item.description: BOURNE – From Bourne Fire: Overnight last night, Bourne Fire/Rescue surpassed 5,299 emergency calls for service in 2025.
